decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate exchangers for HVAC sit at the core of the firm's established portfolio, so the investment in certification and the fit with the announced direction favor keeping them.
The box cooler is publicly promoted as having a major market share in water cooling, a visible commitment that makes dropping it very unlikely.
The marine cooling unit has its own web page and complements the marine cooling line, so its visibility and the resources already invested argue for persistence.
The compact oil cooler builds on the established offer and is only briefly mentioned, but it was launched recently and any weak results can still be blamed on the ramp-up phase.
Finned tubes for air coolers are presented prominently and are a component capability central to the firm's engineering identity, which supports continued commitment.
Enhanced tubes reflect the firm's own R&D and its innovation and efficiency direction, and their dedicated web page signals a public commitment worth defending.
